The *Saññojanavippayuttasaññojaniyaduka* (Patthana 8.25) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [Catalog]. It treats the conditional relations of phenomena classified under the dyad (*duka*) of states that are disconnected from fetters but are themselves favorable or subject to fetters (*saññojanavippayutta saññojaniya*) [Catalog].
